findings.recommendation: block WebRTC (about:config media.peerconnection.enabled=false) or force mDNS obfuscation and verify no host candidates leak

findings.title: ClientHello carries no GREASE values
findings.detail: the hello is fully canonical, so it hashes to a stable JA3/JA4 that survives any exit change
findings.recommendation: a greased hello (variant greased) breaks exact JA3 matching

findings.title: No Tor circuit evidence
